title: Automated report.json (plan-v4 part 08)
description: Contract between assemble_report and report-kit build() in automated mode. Every string carries x-text-class (model, server, kit, src; part 08 1.5). The stored report is always complete; build() projects it per meta.profile (04 4.1).

facts.description: Server facts referenced by {{fact:key}} and {{calc:...}} in model strings, which stay in placeholder form in report.json. check_strings() runs on the placeholder form; project() (08 2.4) substitutes value, or kit withheld_value for amount_at_risk under public_review (04 4.1 effect 4), and drops the matching Figures used rows

unit.description: units.yaml unit word; null for unitless facts

kpis.description: Six server KPIs, plus `documents` when at least one project document was retrieved (context ingestion spec 7)

reason.description: Server rows: fixed reason words. Model rows (by = model): MODEL, part 04 text gate

figures.description: Placeholders in roles rows and notes, one table under the roles table

related_contracts.description: External contracts the reviewed contract interacts with via privileged roles

detail.description: Server text from the run manifest: analyzer name and version, checklist id, disproof pass count

verification.description: Server tables from verify_deployment; present for tier A and C only

build_failure.description: Present when the build failed: compiler chosen, error class and consequence, printed on the cover and in the summary

chain_id.description: Numeric for EVM and HyperEVM, cluster name or null elsewhere (chains.json)

addr_url.description: null when the chain template has not passed the 8.3.5 test; addresses then render as plain monospace

requested_by.description: Part 02 D-ROLE: effective requester_role (default third_party_public_code) and its kit label; printed as 'Authorization declared by requester, not verified by SOKEN LTD: <label>'

enum: Party authorized by the code owner

label.description: Kit text tier_labels with server values filled

source_attribution.description: Provider licence text (09) when the source came from a licensed provider, e.g. Etherscan getsourcecode under etherscan_licence: "Powered by Etherscan.io APIs"; absent otherwise

oneOf.description: No on-chain evidence about an upgrade path was read; the kit prints its not-checked text

dismissed_leads.description: Server data, shown when 0 Critical and 0 High (8.2.3)

reason.description: dismissal_reason (rubric enums), model or server; the audit note never prints

risk_note.description: MODEL, part 04 text gate and number check

model_block.description: MODEL blocks: part 04 text gate T1 to T28 and number check (5.2, 5.3) at submit and again at assembly; strings hold {{fact}}, {{calc}} and {{finding}} placeholders unexpanded, expanded only by project() (08 2.4)

attack_steps.description: MODEL text, rendered only when meta.profile is owner (04 2.3, K8)

category.description: Label of the closed category enum (part 04 7.3); the enum key is validated at submit

status.description: Open, Fixed or Not verified as fixed on every card iff meta.previous_report_id (S5); set only by re-review from the review_start snapshot (03 4.1). Fixed cards are outside the severity counts; Not verified as fixed cards carry the earlier card text and location quotes as earlier-pin code blocks, are counted, and are carried again by the next re-review (08 2.3)

compact.description: true when compact_evidence dropped the code blocks (Low and Informational only)

further.description: Quoted ranges beyond the block cap, printed as 'Further quoted lines'

then.$comment: Since 2026-10-27 (never-worse, gate_policy.yaml F3) a finding without its optional challenge keeps its severity; the card prints evidence reasoning_only and the coverage note counts it. It still carries no challenge table.

allOf.description: Fixed cards carry no model body, at least one dismissal quote and the challenge table with the kill item (08 2.3); every other card carries description, impact and a recommendation. report.json always holds full data; withholding happens only in project() at build (08 2.4)
Not verified as fixed cards keep their location quotes as code blocks of the earlier pin (compact_evidence excepted, Low and Informational), so the next re-review carries them (08 2.3)

enum: Not applicable (marked by the requester's session)

note.description: MODEL, only with code_returned = Not applicable

not_taken.description: Advisory finalize checks that were open when the job was finalized (contract/rubric/gate_policy.yaml finalize_checks); printed with kit coverage_note.lines.<kind>

invariant_walks.description: Invariant walks of the job (rubric invariants.yaml) with the requester's session answer; present only when the job had walks

oneOf.description: Produced by assembly from a {{fact:key}} cell; never sent by the model
Produced by assembly from a {{fact:key}} cell; never sent by the model

figure.description: 04 6.4: one row per {{fact}} or {{calc}}; value, expression, each operand's source. Omitted under public_review when any operand fact is tagged amount_at_risk (04 4.1 effect 4)

expression.description: calc only, rebuilt by the server from the 04 grammar

context.description: Project context (context ingestion spec 7): documents ingested for the job, declared-vs-observed rows computed by the server at assembly, and the reviewer's context_notes blocks. Empty documents print the kit empty line, never an empty table

title.description: Document title as extracted; untrusted web text, SRC class (escaped, never gated)

host.description: Host of the final URL; empty for inline documents (the kit prints its inline label)

sha256_short.description: First 12 hex digits of sha256_raw; empty when the fetch failed

context_row.description: One declared-vs-observed row (context ingestion spec 6). claim is server text from the fixed claim set; declared and its source come from the document (SRC); observed and its source may carry contract names and addresses (SRC)

observed_source.description: Fact source (RPC method and block), map reference or job field; empty when nothing was observed

kind.description: classification from eth_getCode + Safe proxy check

note.description: threshold/owner count (Safe), min delay (Timelock), or unverified notice
